page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-112 is an x86_64 enterprise server instance configured with 112 dedicated vCPUs and 1488 GB of RAM. The instance allocates approximately 13.29 GB of memory per core, providing an exceptionally high memory-to-vCPU ratio designed for memory-constrained enterprise applications. It contains no attached GPU accelerators, focusing hardware resources entirely on general CPU processing and substantial RAM capacity.

Storage architecture on the m4n-megamem-112 relies entirely on external network volumes, as the configuration provides no local disk storage. Similarly, it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating VPC network configurations for public ingress and egress. Tradeoffs include the absence of high-speed local NVMe scratch storage and dedicated matrix-math accelerators, directing its resource footprint purely toward system memory retention and multi-threaded CPU execution.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high proportion of memory relative to CPU makes this configuration suitable for workloads where dataset size dictates server sizing rather than raw computational throughput. The instance profile is primarily aligned with large-scale in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, massive caching tiers, and enterprise resource planning systems that require keeping large datasets directly accessible in memory.
description: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-112 is an x86_64 architecture instance designed for memory-intensive workloads within Google Cloud. Featuring 112 dedicated vCPUs and 1488 GB of RAM, it maintains an extensive allocation of 13.29 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no onboard local storage, depending entirely on network-attached persistent storage for operating system and file operations, and includes zero integrated GPUs. It also provisions no complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. Without hardware acceleration or direct-attached NVMe drives, the system minimizes resource overhead outside of primary memory and compute. This distinct resource footprint makes the m4n-megamem-112 optimal for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise in-memory analytics, SAP HANA environments, and high-capacity caching architectures requiring substantial memory density per execution thread.
